subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Please don’t touch that, it’s __flammable__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Non-combustible.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"flammable"** means something that is easily set on fire or capable of burning quickly. (ज्वलनशील)

 
 
• **Example: **The chemical stored in the laboratory is highly flammable.
 
 
 
• **"Non-combustible"** refers to a material that does not catch fire or burn easily. (अज्वलनशील)
 
 
• **Example: **The building materials used are non-combustible to ensure safety.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'flammable'** is **'non-combustible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Non-combustible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Incendiary** (आग लगाने वाला): Designed to cause fires.

 
 
• **Example:** The incendiary device was found in the suspect's car.
 
 
 
• **Nonexplosive** (गैर-विस्फोटक): Not capable of causing an explosion.
 
 
• **Example:** This chemical is nonexplosive and safe to handle.
 
 
 
• **Fire-resistant** (अग्निरोधक): Not easily burned and able to withstand fire.
 
 
• **Example:** The fire-resistant coating on the walls helped prevent the spread of flames.
